subject: BridgeBank pilot: cost summary, batch/cache levers & next steps
messages:
From: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena.costa@bridgebank.com>
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: BridgeBank discovery follow-up — cost framing and short next steps

Hi Elena — thanks again for the sync today. Quick recap while it's fresh and a proposed immediate plan:  

Key pain / goals we heard:  
- High token spend on customer-facing summarization flows (avg 1.2k tokens/request) causing surprise overages in Q3.
- Need <50ms p95 response for inline UX, but current latency on existing endpoint is inconsistent.
- Procurement needs an ROI narrative and a short pilot that proves savings while keeping model quality.

Cost/TCO thoughts from call (very high level):  
- Token economics: average tokens-per-session at current traffic implies ~$0.12/request at our hosted rates; with batching + prefix KV cache we expect 25–40% reduction on token compute for read-heavy workloads.
- Batching tradeoffs: small batching window (~10–20ms) can reduce per-token marginal cost for peak writes but may need careful client-side retry logic.
- Cache: prefix cache for repeated prompts should help the summarization flows where templates are identical; expect 15–25% token reduction if hit-rate >30%.

Attachments: I attached a short token-econ workbook (bridgebank_token_econ_sheet.xlsx) with the numbers I used below.

Proposed next steps (can we confirm these?):
1) Pilot scope: 2-week sandbox on Redwood Dedicated with a single summarization route (up to 50k sessions/day) to measure real token reduction and p95 latency.
2) Success criteria: >=25% net token spend reduction (after batching/cache) OR p95 latency <=60ms while maintaining fidelity per your QA sampling.
3) Procurement: we'll share a short MAP (attached redwood_map_draft.docx). If procurement needs a PO path, loop in procurement@bridgebank.com and we'll provide a comms-ready one-page summary.

I'll also include Jasmine from our ops team to coordinate procurement and Grace on the rollout plan if you want a dedicated handoff.

Thanks — available for a quick call tomorrow if helpful.

— Priyom
PrIyom Das | Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@bridgebank.com>
To: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@bridgebank.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: BridgeBank discovery follow-up — cost framing and short next steps

Thanks, Priyom — very helpful summary and exactly the areas we want to validate. A few clarifications from our side:  

Confirmed priorities:
- Cost: Finance wants a conservative estimate we can show to the CFO; target is to get token spend below the current baseline by at least 20% in the pilot.
- Latency: Our UX team will accept up to 80ms p95 during the pilot window — 60ms would be ideal but 80ms is the hard upper bound.
- Quality: We will run a 100-sample blind QA for summaries; tolerance for hallucination is very low.

Constraints and asks:
- We have an internal policy that prevents long-term external caching of PII. The summarization route will need to redact or avoid caching PII-containing prompts.
- Procurement will need pricing in a short form (SOW + 30-day trial terms) and a clear statement on data handling and audit logs.

We'll loop procurement if the MAP looks good. Tom — can you confirm an initial budget envelope?

Regards,
Elena
Elena Costa | Head of Digital Products, BridgeBank
elena.costa@bridgebank.com

From: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena.costa@bridgebank.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@bridgebank.com>
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BridgeBank discovery follow-up — cost framing and short next steps

Elena — thanks for the clarifications, important callouts. Quick reactions and adjustments to the proposed pilot:  

1) PII-safe cache: we can implement a cache keying scheme that strips identified PII fields before caching. That will reduce cache hit-rate slightly (estimate in workbook), but respects your policy.

2) Conservative cost scenario: attached workbook now includes a conservative column with no-cache baseline, progressive improvement row for cache+small batch, and a conservative gating line at 20% savings. See tab 'Conservative' in bridgebank_token_econ_sheet.xlsx.

3) Pilot design tweaks:
- Duration: 3 weeks (1 week ramp, 2 weeks steady ops) to ensure we capture traffic variability.
- Traffic cap: we'll cap to 50k sessions/day unless you ask otherwise — preserves budget predictability.
- Monitoring: we'll provide a per-route dashboard showing token rate, cache hit-rate, batching latency, and a sampling hook for QA.

Attached: redwood_map_draft.docx (draft MAP + acceptance criteria). Jasmine — can you confirm procurement comms and a DocuSign flow if BridgeBank is ready?

If Tom can give a ballpark budget range (even a range like $12k–25k for the pilot), we can align the Spend cap and credit terms.

Best,
— Priyom

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena.costa@bridgebank.com>, PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, procurement@bridgebank.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BridgeBank discovery follow-up — cost framing and short next steps

Hi team — looping procurement and ops notes:  

Procurement checklist (quick):
- We can offer a 21-day trial with a capped credit; if BridgeBank accepts, we'll issue a short SOW + trial addendum.
- Standard security addendum: SOC2 Type II attestation + audit log export (we'll provide an extract for the pilot window).
- Data handling: For the pilot we'll mark the tenant as 'no-persist' for PII routes; logs will still include anonymized metadata and trace ids.

DocuSign: I attached a link in the Drive folder. If procurement@bridgebank.com confirms a preferred signer and billing contact, I can pre-fill the SOW.

Operational note: Grace will run the pilot kickoff and coordinate a quick SDK integration session (30–45 minutes) to instrument batching and the prefix cache on your staging environment. Proposed kickoff: Thu 11 Nov 10:00 AM PT (let me know if that works).

— Jasmine Liu
Solutions Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@bridgebank.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@bridgebank.com>, procurement@bridgebank.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: BridgeBank discovery follow-up — cost framing and short next steps

Thanks all — this looks good. Confirming:
- Pilot kickoff Thu 11 Nov 1:00 PM ET / 10:00 AM PT.
- Procurement: procurement@bridgebank.com will review the MAP and sign the trial SOW; billing contact is procurement@bridgebank.com (same inbox).
- Budget: Tom confirms a $15k pilot envelope; we'll aim to keep spend within that and report weekly.

Elena
